text: Some keywords are not combat attributes. Burst and Unstable are printed in purple text and are called non-combat attributes: they describe a card, and generally have nothing to do with combat. The other keywords in this section (Haste, Battle, [once], Ambush and Prophecy) are timing marks, limits and ways to play a card.
